snippet.title: Dog Witch - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Dog Witch combines the best of dice-driven roguelikes and deckbuilders to deliver a rich strategic experience. With quick runs, you’ll harness diverse item sets, discover new synergies and face a wide variety of wild enemy encounters, each requiring clever thinking to master. Check out the Dog Witch trailer to see reactions from the community highlighting challenging gameplay and more. Dog Witch will be available on PC. A new demo for Dog Witch is out now on Steam.


You play as the Dog Witch.... half doggo, half all powerful witch, all bark and bite! You’re on a mission to overthrow your former master, the Mad Master Wizard, and roll your way through a surreal world of haunted vending machines, laser ponies, and skeletal sidekicks.
